# Kaisla

Ranta Aalto's aunt and guardian (D-0229). A secondary role, not core cast.

## The name and the relation

> status: ratified (D-0229)

Kaisla is the settled proper name of [[apprentice|Aalto]]'s aunt, the guardian in whose
house the apprentice is living when the story opens. She is a secondary character and the
fourth speaking role in Arc 1 Episode 1. The name is register-consistent with the family
it belongs to: Kaisla is the Finnic native-register given form (Fi *kaisla*, "reed,
rush"), from the same pool as Ranta (Fi *ranta*, "shore, strand") — the salt-fringes
register the apprentice draws on ([[naming]]). This entry settles the name and the
relation; nothing further about her is ratified.

## Texture

> status: proposed

Unratified, from the Arc 1 development basis: she is ill and cannot move herself, so the
apprentice's ward-work in the flooding low-house is done first to keep her dry and then to
carry her out. She counsels in short, dry imperatives and will not spend a true word on a
lying cord. The development basis also has her reach a borrowed eave and die there of cold
and prior illness — the loss that leaves the apprentice alone.
